name: 3S Chaos Sea
author: Joakim
description: Chaos sea stepper: maps rooms on a 3D grid, queues unexplored exits, BFS-walks to the nearest frontier room; auto mode fights mobs on the way. Reads the room, its contents and combat from GMCP, and takes its arrival signal from the MUD's own room header - so none of the '=S=', '=M=', '=P=' or '=A|W|I=' display markers need to be switched on. Those triggers remain as a fallback for a character or MUD without GMCP, each standing down for any room GMCP has already described. Which exits are still unexplored comes from the server rather than from dead reckoning: in the sea an exit's destination is 0 until you have walked it, so the frontier survives the coordinate collisions a dead-reckoned map cannot avoid. Loop (2.3.0, the Loop button or 'cs loop on'): at the cask the bot kills what is in the room, waits until nothing is hitting it, then runs New Sea by itself - looting the cask and entering a fresh sea - and explores that one too (with Auto on); a sea younger than unsetsea's 60 minutes is waited out, and a player in the cask room is never attacked. 2.3.1 (25 Oct): works for a Changeling - that guild pads its output lines with spaces, so "There is no mutant here." never matched the room-clear trigger and the bot re-sent 'kill mutant' into the empty room for good; every end-anchored trigger now allows trailing whitespace, and padded marker lines no longer carry the spaces into the mob name. 2.4.0 (26 Oct): it finds itself on its own map when it loses its place - after a teleport, or when no queued exit is reachable - by matching the room's Room.Map picture and exits against the saved map of the layer, and goes on from there instead of asking for 'cs reset'. It only moves when exactly one place fits AND enough evidence stands behind it (rare exit sets and confirmed links, more needed on a bigger map), since a room not on the map at all can look like one that is; on Auto it walks up to 30 rooms (writing nothing to the map) to gather that evidence, then gives up paused. 'cs locate' asks the same question on demand. 2.5.0 (27 Oct): the 3D view - 'cs view 3d', or the panel's 3D button, shows every layer of the sea at once on a Scrye with plugin API 1.24: rooms, links, a way down as a vertical line, the frontier targets, the start and you, your layer bright; drag to turn, Shift+drag to pan, the wheel zooms, Reset view puts the camera back. The phone always shows the 2D map, and an older Scrye keeps the 2D map it had.
